authors.bio: Yves Guinet is Deputy Director of the CCETT (TV and Telecommunications Research Center) responsible for research and development in fields of new technology that affect television broadcasting. He has been very active in the fields of teletext and digital video. He is a member of E.B.U. Sub-Group V2 on teletext and has published several papers on the ANTIOPE teletext system in the E.B.U. Technical Review. Currently, Mr. Guinet is serving as chairman of E.B.U. Sub-Group V1 on Digital Coding of Picture and Sound (formerly Working Party C).
